name: tracker-notification-storage
goal: Prove additive startup on pinned 4a6be709 SQLite, unchanged historical delivery state, matching IDs and retry times, exact request replay after a failed acknowledgement, and same-database legacy rollback.

evidence: Pinned 4a6be709 store.js, notifier.js and webhook.js establish table schemas, webhook_seq and cos metadata, callback keys and batch ID hashes. Baseline runtime requires an external queue and has no durable SQLite implementation.

The existing notification cases use injected queues. A new native SQLite method/state matrix covers existing and missing schemas, pause and retry migration, uncertain send, restart, and legacy readback.
